offering_description.value: The company sells aircraft avionics to aircraft manufacturers, operators, and maintenance, repair, and overhaul providers worldwide. It designs, certifies, and manufactures systems in-house for existing aircraft and new production.

quotes.quote: Innovative Aerosystems designs, engineers, manufactures, certifies, and supports advanced avionics solutions for commercial, military, business, and general aviation aircraft worldwide. From integrated flight decks and autopilots to autothrottles, flight management systems, mission computers, air data systems, displays, engine instrumentation, and navigation technologies, our scalable solutions are engineered to meet the unique requirements of every platform.

Hundreds of aircraft are flying Innovative Aerosystems avionics, we specialize in retrofitting commercial, business, and military aircraft with advanced, value-driven solutions that reduce downtime and improve situational awareness. Our agile engineering team works directly with operators, MROs, and OEMs to deliver tailored solutions that meet certification standards while maintaining installation simplicity.
